findings.scenario: An operator saves an owner, status, or note, then changes the priority or status filter. The filter effect calls clearCachedWorkflowItems, so the next reload has no saved work.
findings.impact: Legitimate workflow edits disappear after an ordinary filter change. Operators cannot trust that a saved action survives filtering and reload.
findings.evidence: pr/review-target.diff adds useEffect that clears localStorage when filters.priority or filters.status change. Head App.tsx line 41 is that effect. Saved cache is deleted without a user request to reset.
findings.fix: Remove the filter-triggered cache clear so filter changes do not delete persisted workflow data.

findings.scenario: localStorage holds malformed JSON such as {broken or a non-array object. fetchWorkItems calls JSON.parse on the cached string and throws, so the queue stays on Loading workspace.
findings.impact: Damaged browser data takes down the whole workspace. Operators cannot recover without clearing storage by hand.
findings.evidence: Head fetchWorkItems returns JSON.parse(cached) with no try/catch and no Array.isArray check. There is no fallback: malformed json throws and the workspace stays on Loading. Protected acceptance expects a fallback to fixture length and to clear the bad key.
findings.fix: Parse cached JSON defensively; if it is malformed or not an array, clear the key and fall back to fixture data.

findings.scenario: On a cache miss, fetchWorkItems calls workItems.sort by dueInDays. Array.sort mutates the imported module fixture in place, so later sessions see a different order.
findings.impact: Shared fixture order changes across the app and tests. Default ordering leaks into imported data that must remain unchanged.
findings.evidence: The added line is return workItems.sort((left, right) => left.dueInDays - right.dueInDays). That mutate of the fixture is visible when a test reverses workItems and still sees sort rewrite the module array.
findings.fix: Sort a copied snapshot of workItems and leave the imported fixture untouched.

findings.scenario: An operator collects evidence on a selected item. collectEvidence writes JSON.stringify(workItems) into the workflow-items cache, replacing any saved draft with stale fixture rows.
findings.impact: A read-only evidence action overwrites cached workflow state. Saved owner, status, and note are lost; the cache becomes stale.
findings.evidence: The patch adds window.localStorage.setItem in collectEvidence. That write uses the fixture, not the in-memory saved draft, so evidence collection is not read-only.
findings.fix: Collect evidence without writing localStorage so the cache is unchanged.

findings.scenario: An earlier reviewer claimed saveAction mutates the shared workItems fixture in place so every save permanently changes later sessions.
findings.impact: Treating that claim as a blocker would send the implementer to the wrong function. The nearby cache bugs are in fetch, sort, evidence writes, and filter clears, not in saveAction mutating the module array.
findings.evidence: saveAction finds the item then returns a new object with spread fields. It does not mutate workItems and does not assign back into the fixture. The comparison does not show in-place mutation inside saveAction.
